data.content:
Orbital IT Partners offers the lowest total delivered price for the 50 business laptops, at **USD 36,480**.  
Best price: Orbital IT Partners

additional_kwargs.reasoning_content:
We have data for four laptop quotes: Orbital, Acme, BrightPath? Actually BrightPath has monitors only. Nimbus has laptops. So we need to compare the laptop quotations (RFQ-2026-014). Vendors invited: Acme, BrightPath, Nimbus, Orbital. But BrightPath only has monitors, not laptops. So only Acme, Nimbus, Orbital. We need cheapest total delivered price.

Let's parse each:

Acme: Unit price 742.00, quantity 50 => subtotal 37,100. Shipping 450. Total delivered 37,550.

Nimbus: Unit price 728.00, quantity 50 => subtotal 36,400. Express shipping 300. Total delivered 36,700.

Orbital: Unit price 760.00, quantity 50 => subtotal 38,000. Volume discount 4% for orders over 40 units. So discount 4% of 38,000 = 1,520. So discounted total 36,480. Shipping included. Total delivered 36,480.

Thus Orbital cheapest at 36,480. Nimbus 36,700. Acme 37,550.

Thus answer: Best price: Orbital IT Partners.
